author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm): mix(mean,LSE τ=0.25) + BiGRU(128)
abstract: Learned scalar gating between pooled expert and BiGRU projection with post-fusion LayerNorm. Aggregator uses learned mix(mean, length-normalized LSE, τ=0.25). Tests whether adaptive fusion and scale normalization improve stability and average score.
